topic: Anthropic $2T IPO S-1 lists 'AI backlash' as official risk factor while $11.5B revenue is dwarfed by the $1.2T/year needed to justify the valuation — the S-1 admits the story has an expiration date.
tweet_text:
anthropic just disclosed 'AI backlash' as an official risk factor in a $2T IPO.

$11.5B revenue. needs $1.2T/year to justify the valuation.

wall street isn't buying a business. it's buying a story. the S-1 just admitted the story has an expiration date.

#AI #Anthropic
